mechanism_narrative: Persistently depressed WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicate continued commuter suppression, which keeps daytime shopping trips weak and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks relative to the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 28-day mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not recover by at least 3 points from the snapshot average.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated while WORKPLACES stays deeply negative, households substitute toward home-based routines and reduce discretionary retail visits, lowering RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL exceeds +15 and WORKPLACES remains below -45 for at least one weekly observation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp improvement in PARKS mobility draws activity away from retail corridors on weekends and short leisure trips, causing RETAIL_REC to soften over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline in the week after a PARKS increase greater than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains below -50 and WORKPLACES below -45 simultaneously, the city is in a high-friction mobility regime that suppresses retail access and keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average for four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not stay below the prior 28-day mean during weeks when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain under the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM signals renewed essential-trip confidence and neighborhood circulation, which spills over into discretionary shopping and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM rises for two consecutive weekly observations.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both rise together, outdoor-local activity substitutes for retail outings and reduces demand at retail and recreation venues over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and RESIDENTIAL both increase week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the following 28 days after simultaneous weekly gains in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in PARKS mobility marks favorable outdoor conditions that delay indoor shopping trips, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next one to two weeks while the park signal stays elevated.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains above -35 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to weaken within 7 to 14 days after PARKS stays above -35 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: During reopening, a simultaneous easing in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES increases mixed-purpose travel, which broadens shopping opportunities and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise above its previous 28-day mean within 28 days when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve from the snapshot.
